delivery.outcome: Schema validation resolves the exact repository-local .planfile/config.yaml, refuses parent/global fallback, and retains explicit legacy planfile.yaml support.
nonGoals: No migration of existing configuration data.
No change to Planfile.auto_discover or GitHub credentials.
No dependency, release, or hosted CI policy changes.

architecture.decision: Lock the already-merged repository-bounded schema selection with offline regression cases: local config precedence, explicit legacy support, and fail-closed parent/global behavior. Keep implementation paths untouched because their current changes are dirty in another checkout.
architecture.rollback: Revert the regression test commit; the already-merged bounded discovery implementation remains unchanged.

validation.evidence: Offline CLI cases cover local config precedence, parent fallback refusal, explicit legacy support, and non-mutation.
